name: Horizons Regional Council / Manawatū-Wanganui Regional Council
story: After the February 2004 floods, Horizons’ Flood Plain Mapping Project used LiDAR, digital elevation models and hydraulic modelling to map flood hazards. A 2005 LiDAR survey supplied terrain data later reused in environmental, infrastructure and hazard work.
